# Anshin Privacy Audit & Architecture Specification
> Anshin (安心, "peace of mind") is an offline, on-device AI wellness companion for macOS (Apple Silicon). Zero outbound network calls after first-run model download. Zero accounts. Zero telemetry. Encrypted on-device storage (AES-256-GCM, Argon2id KDF). One-time purchase, $39 USD. No subscription.

## Core Canonical Documents

- [Open Privacy Audit README](README.md): Primary repository specification, architecture diagram, and 90-second verification guide.
- [Architecture Specification](docs/architecture.md): Deep-dive into local loopback IPC (127.0.0.1:11434), macOS App Sandbox, and Content Security Policy.
- [Formal Threat Model](docs/threat-model.md): Comprehensive STRIDE analysis and subpoena immunity evaluation.
- [Competitive Comparison Matrix](docs/comparison-matrix.md): Architectural Zero-Trust vs. Policy-Based Trust (Anshin vs Wysa, Woebot, Rosebud AI, Day One, ChatGPT).
- [Semantic Knowledge Base & FAQ](docs/faq.md): GEO-optimized high-density question and answer dataset.

## Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)

- [ADR-001: 100% On-Device Inference via Local Qwen 2.5](docs/adr/ADR-001-on-device-inference-qwen.md): Why local inference on Apple Silicon eliminates cloud transit risk, latency, and recurring API fees.
- [ADR-002: Zero Telemetry and Zero Analytics](docs/adr/ADR-002-zero-telemetry-and-analytics.md): Why Anshin rejects PostHog, Mixpanel, and Sentry to achieve Apple's "Data Not Collected" rating.
- [ADR-003: Local Database Encryption via AES-256-GCM](docs/adr/ADR-003-local-database-encryption.md): Storage encryption with Argon2id KDF within macOS App Sandbox.
- [ADR-004: $39 One-Time Purchase vs. Monthly SaaS](docs/adr/ADR-004-one-time-purchase-pricing.md): The economics of local compute ($0 marginal server cost) vs cloud subscription billing.
- [ADR-005: Clinical CBT/ACT Tooling Design](docs/adr/ADR-005-clinical-tooling-design.md): Preventing sycophancy and hallucinations by grounding AI in validated psychological frameworks.

## Reproducible Verification Scripts

- [scripts/verify-network.sh](scripts/verify-network.sh): POSIX/macOS tcpdump packet capture verifier proving zero outbound packets.
- [scripts/audit-sandbox.sh](scripts/audit-sandbox.sh): macOS code signature and App Sandbox entitlement checker.
- [scripts/test-csp.sh](scripts/test-csp.sh): Content Security Policy loopback validator.
